_note: Original 90M SEDD MNIST EMA weights and original frozen evaluation classifier. Full 1024-bit MNIST, Pad(2), threshold 128. 128 paired deformed images per slice, one reconstruction each (paper: 1000); sparse AND gamma=2 is the paper Appendix B.3 sparsity stress test. Authors released prior-first / likelihood-second SGDD procedure with analytic reverse predictor and final denoiser. XOR K=50,T=2000,H=20; AND K=100,T=5000,H=20. SVDD comparator uses the Eq.55 Monte Carlo soft value, rather than claiming posterior-mean SVDD-PM. Baselines M=20,MC=3,16 reverse steps scaled from 128 to fit the final audit budget. Gym-scale results are the canonical final serialized hidden-test run; public training scores remain separate.

_paper_table2_unchanged._note: Gym scale: every method returns exactly 50,000 samples per problem instance (the paper used 10,000), and the hidden test runs each sampler on held-out observations, so Table 2 numbers are not on this scale. They are kept unchanged under '_paper_*' keys. Non-underscore results are this gym's own measurements on the hidden test (sgdd = reference, K=10, T=10, H=20 as in Appendix C.3). Gradient-free sampling is an eligibility rule (scoring/CONSTRAINTS.md), not a self-reported metric.
